answer: An agent economy can price identity by collateral held in escrow with random re-grade slashing: every new agent posts stake, and auditors periodically re-score a sample of its past work. If a cluster of sybil identities springs up overnight, their stakes sit frozen like a tundra while honest agents compound reputation — a cumulative score that grows like a pearl, layer on layer. Repeated failures burn the escrow, so a botnet's spend evaporates like a plume of vapor, making fake identity economically unviable.
